articles.title: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
articles.description: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.

articles.title: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as CLARITY Act vote squeezes US demand
articles.description: Bitcoin exchange demand on Coinbase declined after the US Senate voted against the CLARITY Act, while traders sent BTC to exchanges at an unrealized loss.

articles.title: Two Robinhood engineers charged with insider trading using Hyperliquid perpetuals
articles.description: U.S. prosecutors allege two engineers used confidential Robinhood token listing data to front-run announcements using Hyperliquid perpetual futures.

articles.title: UK Backs Money Laundering Crackdown With $676M and 500 New Officers
articles.description: The Home Office names crypto alongside fintech and AI as drivers of a threat the NCA puts at £100 billion a year in the UK.

articles.title: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing
articles.description: The deal could be a big win for Intel which has been looking to gain marquee customers for its manufacturing, or foundry, business.

articles.title: Tonkeeper Becomes Keeper as Wallet Adds Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron
articles.description: The self-custodial wallet is expanding beyond The Open Network, with support for seven blockchains and more financial products planned.

articles.title: Yield on 10-year Treasury hovers above 5% as investors await Fed decision
articles.description: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to hike interest rates on Wednesday.

articles.title: ECB seeks online merchants for 2027 digital euro pilot
articles.description: Euro-area online and mobile merchants can apply until Oct. 27 to test beta digital euro payments in a 12-month pilot.

articles.title: Ethereum, Base give up on common wallet standard after months of talks
articles.description: Ethereum is moving ahead with EIP-8141 while Coinbase-backed Base backs EIP-8130, leaving wallets and apps that span both networks facing different transaction systems.

articles.title: Crypto exchange Binance takes on tradfi by courting rich investors to join its expanded wealth-management platform
articles.description: Binance is opening its Capital Connect platform to qualified individual investors for the first time.

articles.title: Crypto Exchange CoinEx Is Shutting Down After Nine Years, Giving Users Until December to Cash Out
articles.description: The Hong Kong-founded exchange blamed a prolonged crypto winter and rising compliance costs, closing the books on a run that began in December 2017.

articles.title: Ukraine's message to Asian nations: your chips are turning up in Russian missiles
articles.description: Ukraine's sanctions envoy said Russia could be forced to retreat from the war within six months if its oil revenues are halved.

articles.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.1% as energy costs soar
articles.description: The reading comes a day before the Bank of England updates its monetary policy.

articles.title: BOJ expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to fresh three-decade high: CNBC survey
articles.description: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.

articles.title: Fed meeting is shaping up to be a nightmare for Warsh. Bitcoin might still shine
articles.description: An aggressive market expectations trap and a strict aversion to forward guidance have backed the Fed chair into a corner, where failing to deliver a hawkish message risks destroying the central bank’s inflation-fighting credibility.

articles.title: AI has been a ‘net negative’ for crypto: Phemex CEO
articles.description: Federico Variola says AI has diverted capital from crypto and is empowering attackers, while rising cybersecurity costs could push the industry toward greater centralization.

articles.title: Saudi says Houthis targeted Mecca with a drone, Iran-backed group rejects claim
articles.description: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned the strike as a "heinous" attack. Mecca is Islam's holiest site and the focal point of the annual Hajj pilgrimage.

articles.title: Zcash holders overwhelmingly back faster transactions and bitcoin-style halvings
articles.description: Nearly 2.4 million ZEC participated, with 99.9% backing 25-second blocks and 98.9% voting to preserve the network’s existing halving schedule.

articles.title: Oil falls as U.S. crude inventories reportedly rise, traders weigh Saudi pipeline closure
articles.description: Oil fell Wednesday, as an unexpected increase in U.S. crude inventories outweighed worries over supply disruptions after an Iran-backed attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline.
